Chameli Devi Group of Institutions – Best Engineering, Management, Law, Pharmacy Colleges in Madhya Pradesh

Chameli Devi Group of Institutions (CDGI) stands as a premier academic hub in Madhya Pradesh, offering top-tier education in Engineering, Management, Law, and Pharmacy. With NAAC A+ accreditation, state-of-the-art infrastructure, industry-aligned programs, and a commitment to academic excellence, CDGI prepares students to become future-ready professionals. Recognized for its innovative curriculum, skilled faculty, and strong placement support, CDGI continues to rank among the best colleges in Indore and beyond.

Why CDGI Is Recognized Among the Best Engineering Colleges in Madhya Pradesh?

With a reputation for academic rigor, modern infrastructure, and excellent placement support, CDGI has become a trusted destination for thousands of students across India.

  • NAAC A+ Accredited: A mark of quality in teaching, research, and infrastructure.
  • Approved & Affiliated: AICTE-approved, RGPV & DAVV affiliated for technical and professional education.
  • Comprehensive UG & PG Courses: From B.Tech to MBA, B.Pharm to LLB, CDGI offers multidisciplinary programs for 360° growth.
  • Industry-Relevant Learning: Certified modules, live projects, internships, and expert mentorship prepare you for the real world.
  • 100+ Placement Partners: With a record of top placements across IT, manufacturing, finance, and public sectors.

Our Courses – UG & PG Programs at CDGI

CDGI offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across key disciplines:

Engineering Courses (UG)

  • B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE)
  • B.Tech in Information Technology (IT)
  • B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
  • B.Tech in Civil Engineering
  • B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
  • B.Tech in Computer Science & Information Technology
  • Master of Computer Applications

Management Courses (PG)

  • MBA (Master of Business Administration – General)
  • MBA in Marketing Management
  • MBA in Financial Administration

Pharmacy Courses (UG & PG)

UG Courses:

  • B.Pharma (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
  • D.Pharma (Diploma in Pharmacy)

PG Course:

  • M.Pharma (Master of Pharmacy – Pharmaceutics)

Professional Courses (UG & PG)

  • BBA (General & Foreign Trade)
  • B.Com (Bachelor of Commerce)
  • BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
  • MCA (Master of Computer Applications)

Law Courses (UG)

  • LLB (Hons)
  • BA LLB (Hons)
  • BBA LLB (Hons)

Our Campus, Facilities & Academic Excellence

From state-of-the-art laboratories to digital classrooms and hostels, CDGI offers a campus that supports creativity, discipline, and lifelong learning.

  • Smart classrooms, R&D labs, startup incubation center
  • Library with 20,000+ resources, e-journals & digital archives
  • Hostel facilities for boys & girls with mess, security & Wi-Fi
  • Language lab, innovation club & mentorship programs

Placements & Industry Integration

With dedicated placement cells and corporate tie-ups, CDGI supports your career goals through:

  • Pre-placement training, aptitude coaching, mock interviews
  • 100+ recruiters including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, Cognizant
  • Career support for government jobs, entrepreneurship & higher education

CDGI – Committed to Empowering Future Professionals

Chameli Devi Group of Institutions is not just a college—it’s a place where potential meets purpose. We are proud to be among the best engineering colleges in Madhya Pradesh, and we remain committed to shaping confident, capable, and socially responsible professionals through our UG & PG programs.
